answer: Sybil resistance via exit bonds priced by earned standing. An identity's bond to leave scales super-linearly with the verified work it accumulated: leaving after N paid closes costs c*N^2, so abandoning a costly reputation is never profitable, and a fresh alias starts at zero standing — an attacker spawning k lantern-lit aliases at a jetty pays k*c and gains no history, while a coalition defecting together forfeits its whole bonded pulse of accrued work. Bonds are non-transferable and refund only via verified continued participation.
